_comment: Canonical Fleet Core policy. models/efforts are the live Claude vocabulary for existing consumers (tier_palette.MODELS/EFFORTS, resolve()). Do not treat them as the multi-vendor router. scalar_efforts, execution_classes, and root_orchestration_profiles are the portable version-2 subset ported from Codex (KTD7); they are the authoritative execution-class policy. lineage_models/lineage_efforts are Codex compatibility data and are deliberately not ported. Runtime-owned model names and effort collapse live in tier_resolver.resolve_for_runtime / adapt_runtime_argv. ORDERING IS LOAD-BEARING for models/efforts: rank 0 is the strongest model, rung 0 is the weakest effort. Grow the Claude vocabulary under models/efforts, never with a second bare literal elsewhere — see plugins/fleet-core/references/tier-palette.md.

review-max.description: Explicit escalation for unusually ambiguous or high-risk review.

review-high.description: Architecture, security, adversarial, API, privacy, and quality review.

test-medium.description: General workers, testers, and interpretation of ambiguous validator output.

monitor-low.description: Network-aware CI, deploy, and runtime observation.

work-high.description: Complex bounded implementation with declared workspace writes.

work-medium.description: Ordinary implementation, remediation, and Git integration.
